XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay WhatsApp + SMS engagement channel — opt-in preferences.

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_user_channel_prefs
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user opt-in preferences for WhatsApp / SMS / email channels. One row per user. Phase A1 iter 1.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — one row per user (unique)

FIELD.NAME: mobile_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Mobile number with country code, e.g. +919876543210

FIELD.NAME: email_optin
FIELD.COMMENT: Always-on by default. Users can suppress per the existing email cadence engine.

FIELD.NAME: prefer_channel
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary delivery channel: 'whatsapp' | 'sms' | 'email'. Falls back to email when delivery fails.

FIELD.NAME: dlt_consent_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when DLT consent was given. Required before WhatsApp/SMS can deliver.

FIELD.NAME: dlt_consent_text
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the consent language the user agreed to. Stored for audit / DPDP compliance.

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_user_channel_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only audit trail of every preference change. DPDP requires demonstrable consent provenance.

FIELD.NAME: changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the change — usually the same as userid, but admins can edit on behalf of

FIELD.NAME: ip_address
FIELD.COMMENT: IPv4/IPv6 of the request that made the change — required by DPDP for consent provenance

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Audit history per user, newest first

INDEX.NAME: idx_field_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Bulk audit queries (e.g. all dlt_consent_at changes in date range)
